properties.name: hospital:sbom:scope
properties.value: First-party source manifests and installed APT packages resolved from direct build, runtime, test and doc dependencies. Versions and architectures are observed using dpkg-query on the recorded OS, not source-release version constraints. Conditional edges are included without evaluation. External licenses and transitive dependencies are unresolved. Excludes unrelated OS packages, scanner tools and a file/asset inventory. Not a complete installed-system or binary-distribution BOM.

components.name: hospital_arena
components.description: Joint-state bridge: drives the hospital_description URDF model from the controllers' abstract device state so the 3D scene reflects the live system state.

components.name: hospital_bringup
components.description: System-level launch files and parameters to bring up the hospital simulation and UI.

components.name: hospital_controller
components.description: C++ controller nodes that simulate the hospital's doors, CT scanner, lab, and operating room as composable ROS 2 components.

components.name: hospital_description
components.description: URDF/xacro description and meshes for the hospital rooms and equipment.

components.name: hospital_interfaces
components.description: ROS 2 message, service, and action interface definitions for the Hospital Controller (doors, CT scanner, lab, operating room, and robot tasks).

components.name: hospital_robot
components.description: Protocol-driven robot simulation. Hosts the ExecuteTask ward action, keeps a discrete position (one waypoint per room), opens doors and drives the lab, CT and operating-room controllers, and simulates patient interaction with timers.

components.name: hospital_rviz_panel
components.description: RViz panel that commands the hospital simulation (doors, CT scanner, lab, operating room, ward tasks, and recording) over ROS 2 actions and services and shows live device state.
